errors.text_span: 垂直轴标注了“30个模型结果的均值”
errors.evidence: The y-axis has no label. '30个模型结果的均值' (Average of 30 model results) is a legend item corresponding to the light gray bars, not the axis label.

errors.text_span: 最短的灰度柱高约68，对应于编号为2的实验
errors.evidence: The shortest light gray bar, which corresponds to experiment number 2, has a value clearly above 70, not approximately 68.

errors.text_span: 最长的深灰色柱高约为78，对应编号为 10 的实验
errors.evidence: The dark gray bars all have values around 75. The bar for experiment 10 is at 75. None of the bars reach a height of 78.

errors.text_span: 对于每个编号，灰度柱和深灰色柱的高度差异不大，近似于相同的高度
errors.evidence: This is a significant over-generalization and is misleading. For every experiment number, there is a clear and consistent difference in height, with the dark gray bars being noticeably taller (around 75) than the light gray bars (around 70.5).

errors.text_span: 具体来说是不同模型类型的表现
errors.evidence: The legend indicates the chart compares two aggregation methods ('average of 30 model results' and 'voting result of 30 models'), not the performance of 'different model types'.
